tooltip_ability_anc__chargeability.English: This unit can charge units with the 'Capacitor' ability.

tooltip_ability_anc__capacitor.English: This unit can store charges to become more powerful.

tooltip_ability_anc__discharge.English: This unit can unleash an explosion based on its charge.

tooltip_ability_anc__jumpstart.English: This unit can shock enemies, making them conductive. Conductive units shock nearby units, then explode after death.

tooltip_ability_anc__push.English: This unit can push enemies away.

tooltip_ability_anc__protect.English: This unit can absorb nearby damage.

building_ability_anc__improvementlightni.English: {0} gets struck by lightning on the beginning of every turn. Lightning charges adjacent units and infrastructure.

building_ability_anc__powerstorage.English: {0} levels up per lightning strike near it. If {0} reaches its maximum level, it resets and grants 2 population.

tribes_ancients_info.English: Thought to be long defeated, the Ancients rise again! These descendants of the old Polytopian Empire will do anything to restore their rule.

tribes_info2__ancients.English: The {0} have the ability to use forbidden lunar-lightning magic to create lifeforce out of thin air, power ancient technology, and electrocute anyone standing in their way of rebuilding their empire!
